# Transitions Reference

This file is a **data-only mirror** of `skills/stelow-workflow-orchestrator/stages.yaml`.
It is the single source of truth used by the `stelow advance` helper and the
`router` skill to validate stage transitions.

**Do not edit this file manually.** If a stage transition needs to change,
edit `stages.yaml` first and then regenerate this file.

A consistency test in SCOPE-6 asserts that every stage and transition in
`stages.yaml` has a corresponding entry here. Run `npm run test:skills`
after any change to verify.

---

## Stage Order

| Order | Stage | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | triage | Initial assessment. Determine if this is a valid request. |
| 15 | select | Item selection. Rank accepted items, user picks one. |
| 20 | setup | Setup context. Explore codebase, gather requirements. |
| 25 | context | Strategic context. Market analysis, JTBD, domain detection. Gated by `context:5` (appetite/review mode): Product Spec Gate+Auto skips; others use reduced ask. See the context stage, section 5. |
| 40 | shape | Shape stage. Define appetite, hill chart, rabbit holes. |
| 45 | critique | Plan critique. Pre-flight check before gate. |
| 60 | gate | Gate review. Visual approval via visual review required. Use `visual_review` tool (not bash). |
| 70 | scope | Owns the approved Scope Map for feature routes. Shape may propose candidate slices; this stage finalizes the map without creating a second stage. Narrow mechanical refactors may bypass Scope. |
| 80 | interface | Reaction-first Interface Contrast. Preserves the first reaction, compares bounded alternatives, and emits a named disposition. |
| 90 | int-gate | Interface gate. Visual review of all interface proposals. Use `visual_review` tool (not bash). |
| 100 | selection | Interface selection. Human pick via structured question in Interface-Gates modes; LLM decides in Auto / Product Spec Gate (see references/human-gates.md). |
| 110 | planning | Tech planning. Typed scopes + sequencing. |
| 115 | plan-gate | Tech plan gate. Visual review of spec-tech.md via visual review. Only in Product Spec + Interface + Tech Review or Code Diff mode. |
| 120 | execution | Implementation. Execute planned scopes. |
| 150 | verification | Verification. Run full test suite, code review, UI audit, browser testing. |
| 175 | diff-gate | Code diff review. visual review review of working tree diff. Only in Product Spec + Interface + Tech Review + Code Diff mode. |
| 200 | audit | Final audit. Verify all requirements met. |

## Transition Table

### triage

```
next:      select
accept:    select
reject:    (none — stays at triage)
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none — triage has no gate)
```

### select

```
next:      setup
accept:    setup
reject:    triage
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none)
```

### setup

```
next:      context
accept:    context
reject:    triage
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none)
```

### context

```
next:      shape, planning, audit
accept:    shape, planning, audit
reject:    setup
rework:    (none)
gate:      context:5 — Product Spec Gate and Auto skip this stage
           (other review modes use reduced ask; this affects pipeline
           routing but not the transitions table)
```

### shape

```
next:      critique
accept:    critique
reject:    context
artifact:   plans/spec-product*.md
rework:    shape    (shape rework — same stage)
gate:      (none)
```

### critique

```
next:      gate
accept:    gate
reject:    shape
artifact:   critiques/critique-report.md
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none — critique feeds the gate, gate handles approval)
```

### gate

```
next:      scope, execution
accept:    scope, execution
reject:    shape
rework:    (none)
gate:      requires_approval: true
           approval_tool: visual_review
           Visual approval required before advancing.
           Blocked in: bugfix (rework path skips gate in Auto mode)
```

### scope

```
next:      interface
accept:    interface
reject:    gate
artifact:   scope-map.json
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none)
```

### interface

```
next:      int-gate
accept:    int-gate
reject:    scope
artifact:   interfaces/*.md
artifact:   interfaces/contrast.json
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none)
```

### int-gate

```
next:      selection
accept:    selection
reject:    interface
rework:    (none)
gate:      requires_approval: true
           approval_tool: visual_review
           Visual review of all interface proposals required.
```

### selection

```
next:      planning
accept:    planning
reject:    interface
artifact:   interfaces/selected-interface.md
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none)
```

### planning

```
next:      plan-gate
accept:    plan-gate
reject:    scope
artifact:   plans/spec-tech*.md
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none)
```

### plan-gate

```
next:      execution
accept:    execution
reject:    planning
rework:    (none)
gate:      requires_approval: true
           approval_tool: visual_review
           Only in: "Product Spec + Interface + Tech Review",
           "Product Spec + Interface + Tech Review + Code Diff"
           Skipped in: Auto, "Product Spec Gate",
           "Product Spec + Interface Gates", "Product Spec + Interface + Scopes"
```

### execution

```
next:      verification
accept:    verification
rework:    shape    (full rework path — returns to shape)
gate:      (none)
           supervisor: true (host-native supervision when available)
```

### verification

```
next:      diff-gate, audit
accept:    diff-gate, audit
reject:    execution
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none)
```

### diff-gate

```
next:      audit
accept:    audit
reject:    execution
rework:    (none)
annotate:  execution
gate:      requires_approval: true
           approval_tool: visual_review
           Only in: "Product Spec + Interface + Tech Review + Code Diff"
           Skipped in: Auto, "Product Spec Gate",
                       "Product Spec + Interface Gates", "Product Spec + Interface + Scopes", "Product Spec + Interface + Tech Review"
```

### audit

```
next:      (done — workflow complete)
accept:    (done)
reject:    execution
rework:    (none)
gate:      (none)
```

## Gate Conditions by review gate

`state.md` stores the gate set as `config.review_gates: [spec, interface, ...]`.
Each atom independently brings back one gate; an empty set is Auto and runs
none of them. `config.review_mode` is still READ as a compatibility input for
states written before the set existed, but nothing new writes it. A ladder rung
could not express "interface only" or "spec + tech plan", and a set with no
rung used to be read as Auto, which then refused the tech plan as unselected.

| Stage | Gate atom | Selected? | Gate rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| context | - | n/a | `context:5` is canonical: it decides skip, reduced ask, or full ask from appetite and intent. |
| gate | - | always | `requires_approval: true`, `visual_review` required |
| int-gate | - | always | `requires_approval: true`, `visual_review` required |
| selection | `interface` | unselected -> skip | decided by the agent; interface review not selected |
| plan-gate | `tech` | unselected -> skip | skipped; planning redirects directly to execution |
| diff-gate | `diff` | unselected -> skip | skipped; verification redirects directly to audit |

`spec` and `scope` gate no stage: they select which asks wait at `shape` and
`scope` (see `human-gates.md`). Only the three rows carrying an atom
can be skipped by a set; every other gated stage always blocks.

---

## Artifact Requirements (advance guard)

`stelow advance` enforces that required artifacts exist before allowing a
transition. The stage catalog declares these per stage:

| Stage being left | Required artifact |
|---|---|
| shape | `plans/spec-product*.md` |
| critique | `critiques/critique-report.md` |
| interface | `interfaces/*.md` |
| selection | `interfaces/selected-interface.md` |
| planning | `plans/spec-tech*.md` |

Execution scopes and verification evidence remain runtime projections; their
statuses and records are checked by the owning lifecycle rather than guessed
from a missing file glob.

---

## Stub Workflows by Intent

Minimal pipelines (no stage skipped without a gate rule):

**new-product:** triage → select → setup → context → shape → critique → gate → scope → interface → int-gate → selection → planning → plan-gate → execution → verification → diff-gate → audit

**feature:** triage → select → setup → context → shape → critique → gate → scope → interface → int-gate → selection → planning → plan-gate → execution → verification → diff-gate → audit

**bugfix:** triage → select → setup → context → shape → critique → gate → execution → verification → audit
*(interface/int-gate/selection/planning/plan-gate/diff-gate skipped unless the review gates add them)*

**refactor:** triage → select → setup → context → planning → plan-gate → execution → verification → audit

**investigate:** triage → select → setup → context → audit

---

## Regeneration

Regenerate from `stages.yaml` (never hand-edit the generated file):

```bash
python3 scripts/generate-transitions.py
python3 scripts/generate-transitions.py --check  # CI gate: fails on drift
```
